00387 void UGen::constructMultichannel(const int numUGens, const UGen uGenArray[]) throw()
00388 {
00389  if(uGenArray == 0)
00390  {
00391   initInternal(numUGens);
00392   for(int i = 0; i < numUGens; i++)
00393   {
00394    //internalUGens[i] = new NullUGenInternal();
00395    internalUGens[i] = getNullInternal();
00396   }
00397  }
00398  else
00399  {
00400   int totalChannels = 0;
00401   
00402   for(int uGenIndex = 0; uGenIndex < numUGens; uGenIndex++)
00403   {
00404    totalChannels += uGenArray[uGenIndex].numInternalUGens;
00405   }
00406   
00407   initInternal(totalChannels);
00408   
00409   int channel = 0;
00410   
00411   for(int uGenIndex = 0; uGenIndex < numUGens; uGenIndex++)
00412   {
00413    for(int internalIndex = 0; internalIndex < uGenArray[uGenIndex].numInternalUGens; internalIndex++)
00414    {   
00415     internalUGens[channel++] = uGenArray[uGenIndex].getInternalUGen(internalIndex);
00416    }
00417   }
00418  }
00419 }

00593 UGen UGen::operator[] (IntArray const& indices) const throw()
00594 { 
00595  const int numChannels = indices.length();
00596  
00597  if(numChannels == 0)
00598  {
00599   ugen_assertfalse;
00600   return getNull(); 
00601  }
00602  else
00603  {
00604   UGenInternal** newInternals = new UGenInternal*[numChannels];
00605   
00606   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00607   {
00608    const int index = indices[channel];
00609    
00610    if(index < 0 || index >= numInternalUGens) 
00611     newInternals[channel] = getNullInternal();
00612    else
00613     newInternals[channel] = getInternalUGen(index);
00614   }
00615   
00616   return UGen(numChannels, newInternals);
00617  }
00618 }

00692 UGen UGen::range(const int startIndex, const int endIndex) const throw()
00693 {
00694  ugen_assert(startIndex >= 0);
00695  ugen_assert(endIndex < numInternalUGens);
00696  ugen_assert(startIndex < endIndex);
00697  
00698  const int startIndexChecked = clip(startIndex, 0, numInternalUGens);
00699  const int endIndexChecked = clip(endIndex, 0, numInternalUGens);
00700  
00701  const int numChannels = endIndexChecked - startIndexChecked;
00702  
00703  if(numChannels <= 0)
00704  {
00705   ugen_assertfalse;
00706   return getNull();
00707  }
00708  else
00709  {
00710   UGenInternal** newInternals = new UGenInternal*[numChannels];
00711   
00712   for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00713   {
00714    newInternals[i] = getInternalUGen(i + startIndexChecked);
00715   }
00716   
00717   return UGen(numChannels, newInternals);
00718  }
00719 }

00766 UGen UGen::withNumChannels(const int numChannels, const bool addedChannelsWrap) const throw()
00767 {
00768  UGenInternal** newInternals = new UGenInternal*[numChannels];
00769  
00770  if(addedChannelsWrap || (numChannels <= numInternalUGens))
00771  {
00772   for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00773   {
00774    newInternals[i] = getInternalUGen(i % numInternalUGens);
00775   }
00776  }
00777  else
00778  {
00779   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00780   {
00781    newInternals[i] = getInternalUGen(i);
00782   }
00783   
00784   for(int i = numInternalUGens; i < numChannels; i++)
00785   {
00786    newInternals[i] = getNullInternal();
00787   }
00788  }
00789  
00790  return UGen(numChannels, newInternals);
00791 }

00879 bool UGen::containsIdenticalInternalsAs(UGen const& other, const bool mustBeInTheSameSequence)
00880 {
00881  if(numInternalUGens != other.numInternalUGens) 
00882   return false;
00883  
00884  if(mustBeInTheSameSequence == true)
00885  {
00886   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00887   {
00888    if(internalUGens[i] != other.internalUGens[i])
00889     return false;
00890   }
00891  }
00892  else
00893  {
00894   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00895   {
00896    bool foundMatch = false;
00897    
00898    for(int j = 0; j < other.numInternalUGens; j++)
00899    {
00900     if(internalUGens[i] == other.internalUGens[j])
00901     {
00902      foundMatch = true;
00903      break;
00904     }
00905    }
00906    
00907    if(foundMatch == false)
00908     return false;
00909   }
00910  }
00911  
00912  return true;
00913 }

00941 float* UGen::prepareAndProcessBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()

00950 float* UGen::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00951 {  
00952  ugen_assert(numInternalUGens > 0);
00953  ugen_assert(internalUGens != 0);
00954  
00955  if(channel < 0) {
00956   // process all channels
00957   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00958    internalUGens[i]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, i);
00959    
00960    return 0;
00961  } else {
00962   // process one channel and return a pointer to its block
00963   int internalChannel = channel % numInternalUGens;
00964   float* block = internalUGens[internalChannel]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00965   return block;
00966  }
00967 }

00969 void UGen::prepareForBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID) throw()
00970 { 
00971  ugen_assert(actualBlockSize > 0);
00972  ugen_assert(numInternalUGens > 0);
00973  ugen_assert(internalUGens != 0);
00974  
00975  bool shouldDelete = false;
00976  
00977  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++) {
00978   if(internalUGens[i]->shouldBeDeletedNow(blockID)) {
00979    shouldDelete = true;
00980    break;
00981   }
00982  }
00983  
00984  if(shouldDelete) {
00985   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00986    internalUGens[i]->decrementRefCount();
00987   
00988   numInternalUGens = 1;
00989   internalUGens[0] = getNullInternal();
00990   internalUGens[0]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);  
00991  } else {
00992   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00993    internalUGens[i]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);
00994  }
00995 }

01008   filterLoops = blockSize / 3;
01009   filterRemain = blockSize % 3;
01010   reciprocalFilterLoops = 1.0 / (double)filterLoops;
01011  }

01106 void UGen::setInput(const float* block, const int blockSize, const int channel) throw()
01107 {
01108  ugen_assert(block);
01109  ugen_assert(blockSize > 0);
01110  ugen_assert(channel >= 0);
01111  ugen_assert(channel < numInternalUGens);
01112  
01113  if(block == 0 || channel < 0 || channel >= numInternalUGens) return;
01114  
01115  UGenInternal* internal = internalUGens[channel];
01116  RawInputUGenInternal* rawInputInternal = dynamic_cast<RawInputUGenInternal*> (internal);
01117  
01118  if(rawInputInternal == 0)
01119  {
01120   ProxyUGenInternal* proxyInternal = dynamic_cast<ProxyUGenInternal*> (internal);
01121   if(proxyInternal == 0) return;
01122   
01123   rawInputInternal = dynamic_cast<RawInputUGenInternal*> (proxyInternal->getOwner());
01124   if(rawInputInternal == 0) return;
01125  }
01126   
01127  rawInputInternal->setInput(block, channel);  
01128 }

01187    internalUGens[i]->decrementRefCount();
01188    internalUGens[i] = getNullInternal();
01189   }

01191  else
01192  {
01193   // allow the UGens to handle stealing more gracefully
01194   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
01195   {
01196    internalUGens[i]->stealInternal();
01197   }  
01198  }

01391 UGenArray UGen::group(const int size) const throw()
01392 {
01393  ugen_assert(size > 0);
01394  
01395  int outputSize = numInternalUGens / size;
01396  if(numInternalUGens % size != 0) outputSize++;
01397  
01398  UGenArray array(outputSize);
01399  
01400  int inputIndex = 0;
01401  
01402  for(int outputIndex = 0; outputIndex < outputSize; outputIndex++)
01403  {
01404   UGen item;
01405   
01406   for(int i = 0; i < size && inputIndex < numInternalUGens; i++, inputIndex++)
01407   {
01408    item <<= operator[] (inputIndex);
01409   }
01410   
01411   array.put(outputIndex, item);
01412  }
01413  
01414  return array;
01415 }
01416 
01417 UGenArray UGen::interleave(const int size) const throw()
01418 { 
01419  ugen_assert(size > 0);
01420  
01421  UGenArray array(size);
01422   
01423  for(int outputIndex = 0; outputIndex < size; outputIndex++)
01424  {
01425   UGen item;
01426   
01427   for(int inputIndex = outputIndex; inputIndex < numInternalUGens; inputIndex += size)
01428   {
01429    item <<= operator[] (inputIndex);
01430   }
01431   
01432   array.put(outputIndex, item);
01433  }
01434  
01435  return array;
01436 }

01438 UGenArray UGen::toArray() const throw()

01445  }

01472 UGen UGen::interleave(UGen const& rightOperand) const throw()
01473 {
01474  // need to check this...
01475  
01476  if(rightOperand.isNull())
01477   return *this;
01478  else if(isNull())
01479   return rightOperand;
01480  else
01481  {
01482   UGen interleavedChannels;
01483   int maxNumChannels;
01484   if(numInternalUGens > rightOperand.numInternalUGens)

01486   else
01487    maxNumChannels = rightOperand.numInternalUGens;
01488   
01489   for(int i = 0; i < maxNumChannels; i++)
01490   {
01491    interleavedChannels <<= wrapAt(i);
01492    interleavedChannels <<= rightOperand.wrapAt(i);
01493   }
01494   
01495   return interleavedChannels;
01496  }
01497 }

01616 UGen UGen::kr() const throw()
01617 {
01618  if(isNull())
01619  {
01620   UGenInternal* newInternal = internalUGens[0]->getKr();
01621   return UGen(newInternal);
01622  }
01623  else
01624  {
01625   UGenInternal** newInternals = new UGenInternal*[numInternalUGens];
01626   
01627   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
01628   {
01629    newInternals[i] = internalUGens[i]->getKr();
01630   }
01631   
01632   UGen newUGen = UGen(numInternalUGens, newInternals);
01633     
01634   delete [] newInternals;
01635   
01636   return newUGen;
01637  }
01638 }
